title: End link
purpose: Stop a collection being governed by this study.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required; kept in the study's history. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

sections.title: Rules
paragraphs: Only admin and manager can open or submit this form; other roles are refused. The server repeats every check when you save.
The form opens in a dialog over the page you came from; opened directly it is a full page. Cancel returns to that page without saving.

The specimens of the collection are then governed by no study and cannot be distributed until the collection is linked again. Refused while any specimen of the collection is allocated or picked for a request. A link that has already ended shows Not available. The ended link stays on the study, and participants' refusals and withdrawals recorded under this study keep blocking the collection's specimens after it is linked to another study; a withdrawal's holds also reach specimens registered later. If someone else changed the record since you opened the form, the save is refused with a message to reload; the form keeps your entries and the next save uses the current version, so check the current values first.
